value.rationale: The canonical cospectral Shrikhande–rook twins offer a meaningful paired test: maximal-independent-set trace complexes share the exact complete face enumerator and mod-two homology despite different maximal-set counts and different ordinary independence topology, but maximal-clique trace complexes separate in VC dimension and actual topological dimension. Establishing the precise realizability of all Boolean traces is structural new information beyond known clique and independence counts.
